tess: quick context  v3.1.0 artifacts were produced but not yet propagated to some regional private registries; CI reported a skipped quant step for certain CPU targets. Two paths: (A) ask BetaCorp to pin v3.0.9 which is present in their appliance bundle, (B) trigger a regional artifact push/compile (ETA ~2-5h), or (C) use Hosted routing for that model only (requires egress signoff).

raj: 429s likely from hitting local concurrency thresholds. Recommend checking /etc/redwood/agent.conf for max_concurrent_requests and worker_count. Short fix: bump worker_count by 1 and restart agent. If they need sustained load, provision another appliance or use Dedicated trial.
